title: orchis basilica subsp. maculata
intro: Orchis basilica subsp. maculata, commonly known as the spotted orchid, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the orchid family, characterized by its distinctive spotted or marbled leaves. The health benefits of this plant include its potential use in treating various health conditions, such as anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation, due to its adaptogenic properties. The therapeutic actions of Orchis basilica subsp. maculata are attributed to its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which may help to calm the nervous system and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
